text:
Tara Singh: Observed a steady increase in tail latency and a handful of OOMs for mm-1.0 (multimodal) on runtime-4.0-gpu in ap-southeast over the last hour. Looks correlated with longer image+text combos (seq > 6k tokens). Suggest a targeted pin to runtime-3.9-gpu-lv for mm-1.0 in ap-southeast while we investigate kernel scheduling. Any objections?
Marcus Li: Can you share sample logs and whether it's only GPU memory or also CPU/host OOMs?
Tara Singh: Mostly GPU memory alloc failures and some NVLink transfer stalls. Samples below, window 09:04-09:24 UTC.
```
2026-05-10T09:07:12Z model=mm-1.0 runtime=4.0-gpu host=ap-southeast-2 req=mn1 level=error gpu_alloc_fail size=3.2GB
2026-05-10T09:19:50Z model=mm-1.0 runtime=4.0-gpu host=ap-southeast-3 req=mn7 level=warn nvlink_transfer_timeout
```
Priyanka Rao: Scope it regionally. We should avoid a global rollback. Also add a 1% canary to watch for routing surprises.
Tara Singh: Agree. Deploybot supports region and model cohort pins. I'll propose TTL 2h and canary 1%.
deploybot: Proposed: `/pin runtime runtime-3.9-gpu-lv scope=region:ap-southeast models=mm-1.0 reason="gpu-memory-pressure-after-4.0" ttl=7200 canary=1% initiated_by=@Tara Singh`
Marcus Li: Add runbook link in the thread please and notify SRE. We'll collect p95/p99 latency and GPU OOM count every 5m.
changelog-bot: Please remember to add a short customer-facing entry. I can auto-create a draft once the pin is applied.
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-10021 scope=region:ap-southeast runtime=3.9-gpu-lv models=[mm-1.0] ttl=7200s canary=1% initiated_by=Tara Singh. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-10021 hours=1`
eng-sre: SRE notified. Suppressing noisy alerts for pinned traffic. High-sev pager remains for regression spikes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure section "regional pin and telemetry".
Priyanka Rao: I'll open a quick rollback window 09:30-12:30 UTC in case we need to revert or promote an emergency patch.
Marcus Li: I'll start a kernel scheduling/allocator bisect to see which 4.0 change introduced pressure. Posting a debug job to repro on a spare node now.
Tara Singh: Changelog draft: "2026-05-10: Temporary regional runtime pin (ap-southeast) for mm-1.0 due to GPU memory pressure observed on runtime-4.0-gpu. PIN-10021." PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/10021
changelog-bot: Draft changelog PR created: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/10021/draft. Please add any customer-facing details.
Marcus Li: If the debug repro confirms a specific kernel the plan is: patch -> canary -> promote -> unpin. ETA for first repro attempt ~90m.
Tara Singh: If fix lands faster we can unpin early. Otherwise we will evaluate a model-quant profile fallback (lower KV block size) for mm-1.0 as a stopgap.
eng-sre: Will post telemetry snapshots (p95, p99, GPU OOMs) every 10m in this thread.
Tara Singh: Thanks all. Keep this limited to ap-southeast; if you see similar signals elsewhere ping here immediately.
